questions.question: Two different dice are thrown together. The probability that the product of the numbers appearing on them is a prime number is:
Three coins are tossed simultaneously. The probability of getting at least two heads is:
solutionSteps: At least 2 heads: HHH, HHT, HTH, THH. Prob $= 4/8 = 1/2$.

questions.question: The probability of getting a sum of 13 in a single throw of two dice is:
solutionSteps: Max sum is 12 ($6+6$). Sum 13 is impossible.

questions.question:
Two dice are thrown at the same time. Find the probability of getting:
(i) a total of 10
(ii) a doublet
(iii) a sum less than 5

Two different dice are tossed together. Find the probability:
(i) that the number on each die is even.
(ii) that the sum of numbers appearing on the two dice is 5.

Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability that:
(i) 5 will not come up on either of them?
(ii) 5 will come up at least once?
